ayahs.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
ayahs.tr: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
ayahs.tl: Alam tara kaifa fa'ala rabbuka bi ashaabil feel

ayahs.tr: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?
ayahs.tl: Alam yaj'al kai dahum fee tad leel

ayahs.tr: And He sent against them birds in flocks,
Striking them with stones of hard clay,
ayahs.tl: Tar meehim bi hi jaaratim min sij jeel

ayahs.tr: And He made them like eaten straw.
